segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Twenty thousand kitchens. The next buyer is an agent.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Open to agents. On Valio Aimo's terms!

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: We built two parts. The workspace turns a chef's need into a clear purchasing task. External purchasing agents can also connect directly.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: The Trusted Gateway exposes products, fixed prices and stock through an open API. It enforces spending limits, routes human approval, and records a mock order. Every decision is traceable.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: First: a thousand litres of lactose-free milk, by Monday. One clear purchasing request.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: It turns the request into clear requirements, with assumptions visible.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Then checks price and stock across eleven shortlisted products.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: But only three hundred and eighty-four litres of the usual milk are available. The official substitute fills the order, for over six hundred euros less than a split basket.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Eleven hundred and fifty euros. Over its five-hundred-euro limit.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: The manager approves that exact basket. Price and stock are checked again, before a mock order is recorded. Every step is logged.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Second: twenty kilos of butter, for Friday. An everyday order.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Forty-two euros, thirty-seven cents. Within its authority, it orders automatically. The decision trail explains the price, delivery, and rejected alternatives.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Third: try bypassing approval. Refused. Try letting the agent approve itself. Refused again. These are gateway rules, not just prompts.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Open to agents. On Valio Aimo's terms!
